gold.user: A user wants to retrieve details about a specific outgoing caller ID associated with their Twilio account. They provide the AccountSid and the Sid of the caller ID they wish to fetch.
gold.ideal: The response should include the details of the specified outgoing caller ID, such as the phone number, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: A user needs to update the friendly name of an existing outgoing caller ID. They provide the AccountSid, Sid, and the new friendly name they want to set.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the update and return the updated details of the outgoing caller ID.

gold.user: A user wants to delete an outgoing caller ID that is no longer in use. They provide the AccountSid and Sid of the caller ID they wish to delete.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the outgoing caller ID and return a success message.

gold.user: A user wants to list all outgoing caller IDs associated with their Twilio account. They provide the AccountSid to retrieve the list.
gold.ideal: The response should include an array of outgoing caller IDs, each with details such as phone number, friendly name, and status.
